title: New video of the fate of the violating oil tanker in Hormuz
text:
New video of the fate of the violating oil tanker in Hormuz"

"New images have been released of the confrontation with a violating oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz."

"Fars News Agency, Economic Group; new images have been released of the confrontation with a violating oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz."

"The said tanker was stopped and confronted due to violating maritime regulations and warnings."

"Iran has targeted 13 violating oil tankers over the past 7 days.
